================================================================================
for tuple expression
================================================================================

locals {
  x = [for v in var.list : v]
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (for_expr
            (for_tuple_expr
              value: (identifier)
              collection: (expression
                (expression
                  (variable_expr
                    (identifier)))
                (get_attr
                  name: (identifier)))
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
for tuple with key and value
================================================================================

locals {
  x = [for k, v in var.map : v]
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (for_expr
            (for_tuple_expr
              key: (identifier)
              value: (identifier)
              collection: (expression
                (expression
                  (variable_expr
                    (identifier)))
                (get_attr
                  name: (identifier)))
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
for object expression
================================================================================

locals {
  x = {for k, v in var.map : k => v}
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (for_expr
            (for_object_expr
              key: (identifier)
              value: (identifier)
              collection: (expression
                (expression
                  (variable_expr
                    (identifier)))
                (get_attr
                  name: (identifier)))
              key: (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))
              value: (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
for expression with condition
================================================================================

locals {
  x = [for v in var.list : v if v != null]
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (for_expr
            (for_tuple_expr
              value: (identifier)
              collection: (expression
                (expression
                  (variable_expr
                    (identifier)))
                (get_attr
                  name: (identifier)))
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))
              (expression
                (operation
                  (binary_operation
                    left: (expression
                      (variable_expr
                        (identifier)))
                    right: (expression
                      (literal_value
                        (null_lit)))))))))))))
